mapper.select: SELECT d.name AS departmentName, COUNT(a.id) AS appointmentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT doc.id) AS doctorCount FROM department d LEFT JOIN doctor doc ON d.id = doc.department_id AND doc.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN doctor_schedule s ON doc.id = s.doctor_id AND s.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN appointment a ON s.id = a.schedule_id AND a.deleted=0 AND DATE(a.created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} WHERE d.deleted=0 GROUP BY d.id,d.name
